test_title: PYST 22: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/547df8d65f9b57b3e235872fa8bcc754044fd978b1ef019f9a770fb639e4335d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -7.

1. QV-SO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c86121171b753f7db3ad825e25a254939dec3034edca173fe5938a3665434f6e.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -7.
2. OT-QM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d616d41b984dbd3bc74d7fc284c9c211aac564fedc8af6d4f2c0fc33759dc034.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -7.
3. MR-OK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/466a086b85b72bb5b00ac1eac0d05704885cce2ee75098189031469427d90ac6.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -7.
4. SX-UR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c655d5cbbd488c6e04daa72606a7f699c35f2a8244144714473f28650023049.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +2, -7.

Thus, SX-UR is the odd one out.
Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
